6351-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

339-677-4359-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

824-2728-4153-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4153-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4153-5686.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5147-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5147-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3184-4766-5147--190.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment trigger.
Repeat.

654-3129-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-3129-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2021-2060-3129-3334.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1987-4823-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4823-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-4823-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4823-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4478-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4478-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4478-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

678-5296-7741.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-2440-5115-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-2440-5115-7577.description:
Cast the copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares enters, it and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Emeritus of Truce trigger, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Inkling creature token with flying and preparing Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C} since Displacer Kitten and Emeritus of Truce are both Cats.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares, exiling a creature an opponent controls and causing them to gain life.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat any number of times.
If the board state allows, create an Inkling token in step 4 instead of targeting an opponent.
1170-2440-5115-7577.notes: The exact results depend on the board state, but you should typically be able to reach a point where an opponent has more creatures than you and get the most beneficial combination of results.

2438-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
2438-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

206-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
206-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

2438-3991-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-3525-6218.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1429-2981-6792.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

4929-5224-5961.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1247-5963-6410.easyPrerequisites: Marvin, Murderous Mimic does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5963-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
1247-5963-6410.description:
Activate Marvin using Howlsquad Heavy's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

225-880-2692.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
225-880-2692.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1477-2558-5687-5691.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

215-2103-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
215-2103-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1762-2144-3613-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
1762-2144-3613-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wilhelt.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wilhelt's power.
Cast Dress Down by paying {1}{U}.
When Dress Down enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 1/1 Zombie without decayed due to Dress Down.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Zombie's power.
Repeat from step 6.

4050-4516-5075.notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
4050-4516-5075.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Ogre Slumlord trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1806-2034-4314-4666.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the Planar Void trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
